20cc.notes: research-player sweep complete (2026-06-14). 20CC = editor by Falco Paul (player) + Edwin van Santen/EVS (music), Dutch group '20th Century Composers' (Leiden, founded 1988-06-17). 209 HVSC SIDs, all PSID v2, 87% single-subtune. 'World's fastest routine' (4 raster lines). No public source BUT editor's in-tool F7 instructions recovered verbatim (src/20CC_Composer_Instructions.txt). **FC-INSPIRED, NOT an FC fork (settled): F7 text says 'almost the same as Future Composer but this is NOT the same!'; concrete binary diffs vs FC - vibrato=bit-rotation loop (FC=signed-delta), wave dispatch hi-2-bit $00/$40/$80/$C0 (FC=$40/$60), filter only on note-load (FC=per-frame program), Variant-B embeds instrument in note pitch (FC never); own sidid sig, no based-on flag. FC pipeline does NOT transfer wholesale.** TWO VARIANTS: A (174/209) load/init $1000 play $1003, ~2KB, state $1006-6F; B (35/209) load $0FFA play $1081, instrument-in-note-pitch (note&$1F=inst, $E0-FF=cmd) = separate extract path. WRITE MODEL (voice X=2,1,0, offsets $146D={00,07,0E}, all STA $D4xx,Y): freq-hi/lo, PW-lo/hi, **$D418 absolute written 3x/frame (beat-accent mechanism)**, $D404 ctrl/gate (note-load or frame_counter==2 HR); AD/SR $D405/06 + filter $D416/17 on instrument-load only; vibrato=bit-rotation; freq 96-note split table $1485/$14E5. DATA = 2 levels (vs FC's 3): sequence stream (ptr $1545, $00-3F loop/$40-5F repeat/$60-7F waveform-idx/$80-BF arp-swing-param/$C0-FE filter-porta/$FF end) + wave-programs (ptr $154B, hi-2-bit dispatch: $00-3F dur+inst, $40-7F dur+pulse, $80-BF dur+note, $C0-FE dur+freq-lo-hi, $FF end). Instruments 8-byte @ $15FB (byte4=$FF suppresses filter); settings $81=beat-accent $40=appreq(arp?). Features: 2x/3x/4x speed, hard+soft osc restart, sample play, PWM, voice-3 feedback. Address variety = relocation ($FFF/$1000=120, $1670 HeatWave=15, $E0xx=4, $F900=2, scattered=68). Migration first step: disassemble Variant-A Vlindertjes.sid ($106C) for auto-swing/beat-accent/glide algorithms + Variant-B note packing. Cleared to start disassembly. See pipelines/20cc/docs/README.md.

amp.notes: research-player sweep complete (2026-06-14). AMP = Advanced Music Programmer V2.3 by Andrew Miller (=Andras Molnar, 'Burton', Hungarian; Euratom/Quality/Hitech Studio Designs) w/ co-dev + songs by Markus Mueller ('Hayes'), 1988-90; published via Magic Disk 64 12/1991 (CP Verlag, Germany). 246 HVSC SIDs, all PSID v2 / VBL (no CIA). No public source/spec; structure from byte-stable HVSC inspection + binary credits string (src/). LAYOUT ($1000, 142/246, kernel byte-identical bar ~10 SMC bytes): $1000 JMP init/$1003 JMP play; $100B-15 song config (voice_enable/filter_route/order_len/repeat/pattern_count/speed); $1016-2D 12x2B LE pointers (3 voices x 4 track tables); $102E-8F per-voice state 7B stride X=0/7/14; $10D8 freq LO 96 / $1139 freq HI 96 (PAL, entry24=C2=$041B, entry0=silence); $119E-162D kernel. WRITE MODEL per play(): per-voice decode (AD/SR from instr program, freq+vibrato->$D400/01, PW $D402/03, wave+gate $D404); filter sub x3 (filter_table->$D416, master_vol|filter_mode->$D418); $D417 reso+routing; tempo+loop. SMC: init patches ~5 kernel addrs (vibrato x2/filter/glide x2) - rebuild emits clean code per CORE TENET. TRACK FORMAT per voice = 4 parallel byte arrays (note/transpose/instprog_lo/instprog_hi); instprog hi:lo = double-indirect ptr to wavetable-style instrument programs. INSTRUMENT (16 params): AD/SR/pulse-hi/add-pulse/vibrato s-e/accord(arp German Akkord) s-e/filter s-e/wave start1-end-start2/glide/filter $D417/$D418. NOTE encoding: hi-2-bit class + lo-6-bit note#, GERMAN note names (H=B), $80 rest/$40 hold/$00 empty. Editor 4-file format .SNG/.VOI/.NOT/.DAT. Address variety = relocation/packaging of ONE kernel (canonical $1000=142, +3-offset demo-hook=25, $C003/$2800/$E000 reloc); EARLY EURATOM 1988-89 $13xx (8 SIDs) MAY be a pre-v2.3 driver (2nd path?). Migration first step: disassemble canonical $1000 tune for note_byte->index formula + instrument-program terminator + gate/HR mechanism (~$14C8). LEAD: A.M.P. V2.3 Pack (CSDb #200544) reportedly has Cobra's docs. Cleared to start disassembly. See pipelines/amp/docs/README.md.

cyberlogic.notes: research-player sweep complete (2026-06-14). Cyberlogic SoundStudio (CSS) V4.0, 1991-92, German scene - player code by Oliver Klee ('Odi') + music/data/concept by Sascha Nagie ('celticdesign'), group Demons of Sound. 196 HVSC SIDs, all PSID v2 / VBL (speed=0). No public source/spec/manual; structure from byte-stable HVSC inspection + Oliver Klee's first-person STIL comments on ~14 tunes (richest primary source - filter quirk, CSS packer, low-raster variant, porta/arp/PWM). Author split confirmed by embedded string 'MUSIC SASCHA NAGIE, PLAYER O.KLEE'. SELF-CONTAINED (each SID embeds player+data). LAYOUT ($1000, 133/196): 6-entry jump table (init+0/play+3); ASCII string load+$12; state $1032-A0; 13 parallel 32-entry instrument tables $17D8-1916; 95-entry freq table $1928/$1987 DOUBLES as pattern-pointer table (dual-indexed); 6 section-metadata arrays $1C0E-5F + 3 voice->pattern tables ($19E6/$1A9E/$1B56); pattern streams $1D0E, terminated by $2A $2A $2A ('*** END OF MUSIC ***'). WRITE MODEL (voices X=2,1,0, V3 first): per voice D401(freq-HI)->D400(freq-lo)->D402/03 PW->D405 AD->D406 SR->D404 ctrl/gate (FREQ-HI-BEFORE-LO is unusual fingerprint); global D416->D417->D418 once/frame, $D418 value from PER-SECTION table $1C5E[section] (not fixed - source of STIL filter quirk). NOTE encoding 1 byte: upper nibble=instrument (LSR x4 per sidid sig), lower=pitch step; interleaved duration+command bytes. $6000 cluster (13) = TWO unrelated engines: SID*Nation (celticdesign 2013, LSR x6 init) + Timeout (Blue Ninja 1992 'MINIPLAYER3.0 91 BY TBN', early Odi 4-entry jumptable). Player NOT frozen - >=2 generations (Odi orig + 1996 rev 'LARS HUTZELMANN 96 PLAYER O.KLEE'). Composers all German: Nagie (120/61%), X-Radical (28), Blue Ninja (24, extended CSS as Protovision game engine), Odi (24). Migration first step: disassemble canonical $1000 tune for $80-FB effect-opcode map + $FC/FD args + section-advance trigger ($1035) + $1C0E SMC sentinel; handle >=2-3 generation layouts. LEAD: Soundstudio.prg (zimmers.net, 12/11/92) + css.d64 (CSDb #170632) editor binaries. Cleared to start disassembly. See pipelines/cyberlogic/docs/README.md.

cybertracker.notes: research-player sweep complete (2026-06-14). CyberTracker = native C64 tracker by Bjarke Norgaard Laustsen (CyberBrain)/No Name, 2001. 255 HVSC SIDs, all PSID v2 / VBL speed=0 (zero CIA), <=2 subtunes. WELL-DOCUMENTED: full feature manual public at noname.c64.org/tracker/ (saved verbatim in src/). Cyberbrain_Digi (separate digi) + Cyberlogic_SoundStudio (different engine) are NOT this family. TWO SIDID STRINGS = same musical format, DIFFERENT player implementations + write ORDER (need 2 paths or USF write_order flag): CyberTracker(_ct, 125) = the tracker's PSID save, engine FOLLOWS song data so init floats $1DC0-2BBE play=init+$51 (position-dependent, abs addrs patched at save) - 87 native + 35 Packer-fixed-$1000; CyberTracker_exe(130) = Executable Maker output, fixed $0800/engine $4800-5600/init $53A2 play $53E2 gap $40 (98.5% one layout, covers ~51% of all tunes from one disasm). WRITE-ORDER DIFF: _ct freq interleaved V1(lo,hi)V2(lo,hi)V3(lo,hi); _exe all-lo-then-all-hi V1lo,V2lo,V3lo,V1hi... (same for PW); ctrl/ADSR/SR/filter/vol order identical. WRITE MODEL: ~25 regs/play + HR writes (SR/AD=0/gate-clear/gate-set); state page _ct $10xx mapped (Ybase $1046={00,07,0E}, freq $1090-95, PW $1096-9B, ctrl $10B1-B3, ADSR $10B4-B9, filter $10A8/A9/BA, vol $10BB); _ct magic 60 60 60 'ct' at $1006; _exe 13-entry envelope dispatch $47F6. DATA MODEL (manual): 3-ch FastTracker patterns (NOTE/INST/EFFECT, <=128 lines, 256 patterns, 796 shared lines), tracks share patterns+insts (orderlist differs); 31 instruments x 8 graphical envelopes (vol/wave/PW/filterpass/cutoff/reso/pitch/pitchmode, 768 shared points); 20 effects incl Dxx MULTI-EFFECT chaining (255-line table, signature feature); one filter all 3 ch, lowest-ch-wins; Fxx tempo, speed<3 HR issues. Versions V1.00(#2601)->V1.01(#25, fwd-compat)->ExeMaker->Packer. **BYTE-LEVEL FILE FORMAT OBTAINED (user-supplied Wayback capture of CyberBrain's own ctfileformat-1_01 spec -> cluster_byte_format.md + src/ctfileformat-1_01.txt): NO PACKING in files (raw runtime tables); .ct header magic 00 04 'nntrkmzx'; length-prefixed tables VIBDPT/VIBSPD/ARPEGGIO/ADSR/INSNAM(screencodes)/MLTEFF/SNGLEN/SNGREP/LOOPSTART/ENVX-Y-LO-HI(768 pts)/PATTERNS/PTNLEN/ENVLEN/TRKMEM; pattern cell=3 bytes %nnnnoooi/%iiiiEEEE/%eeeeeeee x3 ch=9B/line (instrument#=5-bit split byte1.bit0+byte2.hinib; note 0-15 w/ 13=gate 14=stop); envelopes=16-bit (x,y) in 4 split tables, per-env len from ENVLEN, loop LOOPSTART $FF=none; ADSR sustain nibble always 0 (vol-envelope drives sustain). .ci instrument file = one instrument's slice.** Data model now needs NO RE; only file<->in-memory ($10xx/$53A2) offset binding remains (one disasm). Migration first step: disassemble one _exe $53A2 + one native _ct tune to bind the spec's tables to runtime addresses. Cleared to start disassembly. See pipelines/cybertracker/docs/README.md.

ems_odie.notes: research-player sweep complete (2026-06-14). EMS = 'The Electronic Music System', native C64 editor by Sean Connolly ('Odie') of Cosine (UK), from 1989; V7.03 released 1997-01-18. 196 HVSC SIDs (EMS/Odie). WELL-SOURCED: official V7.03 disk (CSDb #4649 ems_v703.d64) downloaded, 7 bundled HELP files decoded from PETSCII -> complete feature model (src/*.txt). FEATURE MODEL: 3-level Tracks->Sequences->Notes; up to 8 tunes/module, 3 voices, 96 sequences (<=$FF bytes), note dur <=$40. Track cmds: rst/stop/fad/tmp($02-0D)/tr+/tr-/it(inst transpose)/rep/seq# $00-5F. Sequence cmds: notes C0-B7, vol(+filter+reso), ^(glide), event(screen-sync), hdnon/hupon(osc glide), arpon/vibon, arp/sfx/dur/fil, slion/cycon/porton, sus/gat, nrep. 15 INSTRUMENT PARAMS: firstwf, wf+gateoff(5-bit tab idx+3-bit gateoff), AD, SR, pulse lo/hi, pulse rate/delay/min/max, vibrato delay, osc-delay+vib-depth, vib speed, soundtype(0=vib/1=arp/2=osc-gl-dn/3=osc-gl-up/5=hi-freq), filter hibyte, filter table, arp override. 24 waveform/24 arp/24 filter tables. Vibrato amplitude-compensated; glide=division routine; filter NOT sped by multispeed. Player API = 5-entry JMP table (init/play/engine/clear/fade), relocatable. WRITE MODEL (V7.03): voice V3->V2->V1 (X=2,1,0, voice0 inside global-filter JSR); per voice freq lo/hi->PW lo/hi->ctrl; global $D418(vol+route)/$D415/16/17; HR gate-off frame before gate-on. THREE GENERATIONS (distinct sidid sub-sigs): V7.03 (5-JMP, LDY#$16 clear, Y from $1015,X); V9.x (scene V8/V9: dispatcher passes Y=SID-base param to uniform JSR, mutually exclusive w/ V7.03); V10.x (init ASL/ROL table-expand 83-entry $53 = DECOMPRESS packed freq data + SMC subtune patch). RELATED ODIE STRINGS all=Connolly but DISTINCT players (separate targets): Odie/Cosine(9, pre-EMS, $80 sentinel), Odie_tiny(3, ~1K 4K-compo), Odie/Pulse(2, oldest, CPU banking+KERNAL). Digital_Systems NOT Odie. CORPUS: 195 PSIDv2+1 v3(2SID Lovefunk), 195 VBI+1 CIA(Brian_the_Lion s1), 87% single-subtune, 72% canonical $1000/$1003, 37 (init,play) pairs; Merman 99/50% (1999 Ozone covers), Connolly 61, TMR 13. Migration first step: disassemble V7.03 $1000 tune for instrument-record byte offsets + stream/table wire format; handle V7/V9/V10 dispatch + V10 packed-freq decompress; Brian CIA->per-irq, Lovefunk->6-voice. Cleared to start disassembly. See pipelines/ems_odie/docs/README.md.

Jeff = custom player(s) of Soren Lund ('Jeff'), Danish (1974-2013), Cyberzound Productions/Camelot. 192 HVSC SIDs (engine 'Jeff'), 178 his own. ~30 players + 2 editors over career; no public source. Editors: CZP Music Editor V2.0 (1996, never released, .d64 CSDb #122334) + X-SID (Viruz 2007, 6581.dk/xsid-viruz.rar). Jeff_Minter (2) is the unrelated Llamasoft dev. BINARY (V9.x dominant, $1000, version str '-PLAYER V9.6 (C) JEFF / CAMELOT-' @ $1020): 2 JMP trampolines; per-voice state $1040 (7B stride X=0/7/$0E); freq lo+hi 96-entry tables $10C4-$1183; arp/vib semitone offsets $1184; init $11A4; play+fx $12F0-$17B7; 16-bit address table $17C8 (orderlists->instruments->patterns); instrument programs + pattern data $18xx+. PATTERN: (dur,note)* term $FF (note $01-7B semitone, $7F tie, $7D rest). INSTRUMENT PROGRAM: (dur,wave)* ($41 pulse+gate/$21 saw/$81 noise/$FE loop). WRITE MODEL (VBI speed=0): $D418 unconditional first write/frame; per voice (X=0/7/$0E) $D415/16 filter(cond), $D402/03 PW, $D404 gate-off+oldwave (HARD RESTART), $D405/06 ADSR (new note not tie), $D400/01 freq (note or glide/vib), $D404 gate-on; $D417 init-only. Additive freq lookup ((ctr&$1F)*8 into split table). FEATURES (Remix64 interview): JCH-like 2-level track/seq; wave-freq/glide/detune/vibrato/ADSR-manip tables (tremolo/echo/reverb); heavy pulse+filter; multispeed via wave-freq tables; max $1C rastertime. VARIANT TAXONOMY (binary-confirmed, NOT all one engine): BullSID/FLT/BullSID3 = SAME V9.x core, init-only micro-variants (fold into one path); Jeff/Airwalk = OLDER different engine (V4, 3-ZP-pointer $F9/FA/FB); Jeff/XLarge = different tiny direct-table player; X-SID(2007) = genuine redesign (all regs/frame). Plus $FD0-era (19 SIDs, 1991-94) = earlier predecessor gen. CORPUS: 78.5% $1000/$1003, 6 multi-subtune (FLT 2-sub=6581+8580), all PSID v2; Soren Lund 85%, Duck LaRock 14. Migration first step: disassemble V9.x tune for instrument-program opcodes + address-table indexing; CZP Editor V2.0 .d64 (#122334) = format-by-example; handle $FD0/Airwalk-V4/XLarge/X-SID as separate small paths. john_player.notes: research-player sweep complete (2026-06-14). John Player = beginner-friendly C64 tracker by Aleksi Eeben ('Heatbeat', Finland), CNCD/Cyberiad, 2001-02. 183 HVSC SIDs. load/init $1000, play $1003, <8 rasterlines. **★ FULL WLA-6510 SOURCE RECOVERED** (V1.0+V1.4 source.zip + V1.6 player) -> src/v10/, src/v14/, src/player.asm (+editor/packer/disk). BEST-SOURCED family of the sweep; data layout from primary source. Other John_* sidid strings (Darnell/Hancock/Prince/Klonaris/Kyle Johnson) are UNRELATED. DATA LAYOUT (reloc $1000, V1.x): FreqTab +$0358 (84B=42 word/semitone), VibTab +$0400 (32B sine), SoundTab +$0420 (11B/sound), shared 64-step FilTab +$0500/WaveTab +$0540/ArpTab +$0580, Sequencer +$05C0, BlockData +$0600. SOUND DESCRIPTOR (11B): AD,SR,trig-pos,end-pos,loop-pos,PWM-init,PWM-rate,PWM-top,PWM-bottom,filter-reso/chsel($D417),filter-type/vol($D418). PER-STEP cols: waveform->$D404, arpeggio ($00-7E rel semitone/$80-FF abs pitch-hi), filter-cutoff addend->$D416 (voice1). BLOCK STEP 8B: [-][-][v1note][v1snd][v2note][v2snd][v3note][v3snd]; note 0=empty/$01-7F idx/$FE=gate-off mask (patched into AND #$FE, NOT loop). 8 BLOCK COMMANDS: End/Brk/Flt/Tmp/Ini(vib width)/Vib(rate)/Mod/Off. musicshop.notes: research-player sweep complete (2026-06-14). The Music Shop = 1984 COMMERCIAL C64 music-composition program by Don Williams / Broderbund ($44.95, 1984-09-27; MIDI version 1985 via Passport). 182 HVSC SIDs. **It's a GRAPHICAL STAFF-NOTATION editor, NOT a tracker** - most application-like target. Full 50-page manual recovered (src/manual_full_text_extract.md). RIPPED COMMERCIAL APP not relocatable player: 180/182 fixed init=$A04D play=$575A (PSID load=0 -> payload $95F6); play vector NOT in payload - init copies stubs to low RAM (~$575C/$5E46). **CIA-TIMED: PSID speed=0x01 confirmed across corpus -> needs --writelog-per-irq verdict (NOT flat 50Hz).** BINARY (3 regions, byte-stable player): player stubs $95F6-A0FF (2570B identical, note-walk SIDId sig $978A, duration table $97D0=[0,20,40,60,80,100,120,140]); song header $A100 (->$77D4: step_size $77D5=4-20 varies, 'MS' magic $77E0, per-voice ADSR 5B x3, CIA tempo $77DA); note data $A200 (->$78D4: ALWAYS 480 columns x step_size bytes, first 12B zero). NOTE FORMAT: 2-byte SID FREQUENCY pairs [lo][hi] LE ($0000=rest) - validated vs known scores (Canon-in-D D6=$4E68); markers $FD tie/$FA end/$FC loop/bit7 rest. Note-walk $978A = relative-offset LINKED LIST (reads 2-byte offset + step_size, advances per-voice ptr $3F:$40). PLAYER STORES SID-FREQ DIRECTLY (notation->pitch done at save time) - don't re-derive from staff. step_size extra bytes = gate/duration/vibrato/filter/PW (sub-structure = main RE gap). MUSICAL MODEL (manual): <=20 pages, 3 voices=3 SID osc (<=3 simul notes/col), pitch by staff position, durations whole-32nd+dotted+ties+triplets, any time sig; per-voice SID synth ADSR/waveform/control(gate/sync/ring/vib)/PW/filter; 8 FACTORY PRESETS switchable mid-score via COMMODORE+1-8 events; tempo/vol/vibrato globals. .seq save = screen layout (symbol-code+vertical placement), but the SID EXPORT (HVSC) is already the freq stream. CORPUS: 180/182 fixed layout, single-subtune except Karateka (20, Francis Mechner); folders DEMOS/UNKNOWN/Music_Shop 121 (intl community, 1988 crack), Williams_Don 28, Safavy_Mehdi 20. Migration first step: disassemble $575A/$978A player + siddump --writelog correlate to decode step_size column sub-structure (gate/dur/vib/filter/PW) + CIA tempo. Cleared to start disassembly. See pipelines/musicshop/docs/README.md.
